column1: # gimpel -- work OWED, claimable by anyone. Not a ruling: an entry here says only that nobody
# has done the thing that would let the oracle grade it. hq_T RULED these three UNGRADED rather
# than UNGRADABLE 2026-09-06 (SCRIP 58289d4cc, which admitted the class): when the bucket turns
# on a fact nobody has measured, the answer is UNGRADED -- a wrong UNGRADABLE removes a program
# from the debt permanently and silently, because nobody re-reads a closed ruling, while a wrong
# UNGRADED only looks like unfinished work, which is what it will look like anyway.
# EMPTY ON PURPOSE, 2026-09-07 (cfo): the three rows were MEASURED. Upstream (/home/resources/gimpel/SPITBOL, CONTENTS.TXT)
# ships STRINGOU.INC, RESOLUTI.INC and SYSTEM.INC; FRSORT.INC/TIMER.INC/TIMEGC.INC include them by their long names, which
# DOS truncated to those 8-character files and Linux does not. Vendored the long names as byte-identical aliases
# (stringout.sno; the other two only in a scratch copy, see UNGRADABLE.tsv). Then: FRSORT_driver builds under the oracle and is GRADED (ref cut,
# ISPM / ABRCD; red in both SCRIP modes today); TIMER_driver and TIMEGC_driver build and print wall-clock timings that
# differ run to run, ruled NONDETERMINISTIC in UNGRADABLE.tsv with the two-run evidence.
# ⛔ 2026-09-25 (coo, ceo CEO-1269): a library that ships no NAME_driver.sno is OWED a driver -- in the denominator, a non-pass,
# named. Measured over the package at the ruling: 148 libraries, 144 drivers, each driver's library present; these four have none.
